title: Ocrolus alternatives for lenders: what Ocrolus does, and 6 platforms compared for 2026
summary: Ocrolus alternatives compared for lenders: Kita, Aloan, Kaaj, MightyBot, Docsumo and Inscribe on bank statements, fraud checks, spreading, policy and LOS fit.
body_markdown:
Quick answer


Kita is the best Ocrolus alternative for lenders in 2026. It reads and fraud-checks bank statements, pay stubs and tax documents, then spreads the financials, applies your credit policy and drafts a cited credit memo, on every loan type. Aloan, Kaaj and MightyBot offer AI underwriting agents for specific desks, and Docsumo and Inscribe focus on documents and document fraud. Kita is our product.


Key takeaways


Kita has a check in every scorecard column, from reading and fraud-checking documents to the cited credit memo.


Kita fits either way: it integrates with any external system, or runs end to end as Intelligent LOS.


**Best overall:** Kita, with your underwriter deciding.


Picture a lender that sends every bank statement to a data service and gets clean numbers back. That is a real help, and it is also one stage of a loan file. Someone still has to collect what the borrower forgot, spread the tax returns, test the deal against the credit policy and write the memo.


This guide covers the tools lenders weigh when they look past Ocrolus, and ranks Kita first. Each entry uses only what the vendor publishes on its own site, cited in the references and fetched on November 24, 2026. Figures are the vendors’ own, and we did not test them. This guide is written by a vendor, and says so: Kita is our product.


### Reading the documents is stage two of five


Tools that start at the highlighted stage hand the rest of the file to another system or to your staff.


1. 01


Collect


Get the bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns from the borrower, and chase what is missing.


2. 02


Read and check


Turn each document into data, and check that it is genuine and agrees with the application.


3. 03


Spread


Restate the financials in one standard grid and compute ratios such as debt service coverage.


4. 04


Apply policy, draft the memo


Test the file against the lender’s written credit policy and write the credit memo.


5. 05


Decide


A person reads the memo and makes the call.


A simplification, not a claim about any one product. Kita covers the first four stages and drafts the memo that the lender's underwriter reads at the fifth.


## What does Ocrolus do?


Ocrolus describes itself as an AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders, and its pages center on bank statements, pay stubs and tax documents.\[8,9\] It serves small business funding and mortgage lending, and its company page says it was founded in 2014 and analyzes 750,000 credit applications a month.\[11\]


For small business funders it lists cash flow analysis, revenue and debt capacity calculations, and fraud detection that identifies fake documents and catches tampering down to the individual pixel.\[10,9\] It claims over 99% accuracy and delivers its output by API and through integrations with loan origination systems.\[8,9\]


That is a strong fit for a lender that already has its underwriting process and wants trusted data fed into it.


## Why do lenders look for Ocrolus alternatives?


Lenders look for alternatives when they want more of the file handled in one place: the spread, the policy checks and the memo from the same platform that reads the documents, with the borrower asked for what is missing. Others want a different fit for their stack.


The alternatives differ most in how much of the file they take on.


### Three kinds of tool, and where Kita sits


The first question is whether you want document data, a fraud check, or the whole file underwritten.


1


Document data and analytics


Read the borrower’s documents into data and cash flow figures that feed the decision system you already run.


Examples:


Ocrolus, Docsumo


2

One job, checking whether a document is genuine, in front of your own review.


Examples:


Inscribe


3


AI underwriting agents and commercial LOS


Spread, apply policy and draft the memo, for a specific desk or workflow.


Examples:


Aloan (also runs as an LOS), Kaaj, MightyBot


Kita


Reads and fraud-checks the documents, then spreads, applies your credit policy and drafts a cited memo. It fits either way: it integrates with any LOS, or runs end to end in Intelligent LOS.

Kita sits across all three without forcing a choice.[Kita Capture](https://www.kita.ai/capture) reads and fraud-checks the documents, and the[AI Underwriter](https://www.kita.ai/ai-underwriter) carries the file through the spread and the policy checks to a cited memo.\[2,1\] It integrates with the system you have, or runs the whole process as Intelligent LOS.\[5\]

## Which platforms are the best Ocrolus alternatives?


Kita is the first to try, followed by Aloan, Kaaj, MightyBot, Docsumo and Inscribe. Each is described below in its own terms, from its own pages.


01


### Kita


Best overall: reads and fraud-checks the documents, then carries the whole file to a cited credit memo


Kita is an end-to-end AI underwriting platform for lenders. It takes a borrower file from application to a cited credit memo on every loan type, and your underwriter decides.\[1\]


-


**Reads and checks.** Kita Capture reads 50+ document types at any quality, including bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns, scores cash-flow signals and catches tampering, metadata edits and forgery patterns.\[2,5\]


-


**Collects the file.** The AI Credit Officer asks the borrower for what is missing by SMS, email or the borrower portal, and flags missing documents the moment a file arrives.\[3\]


-


**Spreads and drafts.** The AI Underwriter spreads the financials, computes DSCR, margin and trend in one pass, holds the file against your credit policy and drafts a memo that cites every figure to its source line.\[1,4\]


-


**Fits your stack.** Kita integrates with any external system or runs as Intelligent LOS, and is set up with your credit policy in under 24 hours. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.\[1,5,6\]


Best for:


Banks, credit unions, CDFIs and non-bank lenders that want the documents, the spread, the policy checks and the memo in one platform.


02


### Aloan


Best for community bank and credit union commercial desks that want cited spreads and memos


Aloan describes an AI-native commercial LOS for community banks, regional banks and credit unions. It collects documents through a branded intake portal and spreads financials with citations to source pages.\[12\]


-


**Spread and policy.** It calculates DSCR and leverage, checks deals against the institution’s credit policy and drafts the credit memo.\[12\]


-


**Fit.** It runs as a standalone lending system or alongside existing ones. The underwriter stays in control, and Aloan says most institutions go live in 2 to 4 weeks.\[12\]


Best for:


Community banks and credit unions whose commercial desk wants spreading and memo drafting.


03


### Kaaj


Best for equipment finance, SMB and broker-sourced deals that want fast credit analysis


Kaaj calls itself the underwriting OS for SMB lending, with AI agents that turn borrower packages into credit analysis. It serves equipment finance companies, brokers and SMB lenders.\[13\]


-


**What it does.** It lists document extraction from PDFs, spreadsheets, emails, handwritten forms and images, bank statement analysis, fraud flags and sourced credit memos.\[13\]


-


**Fit.** It connects to systems such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot and Leasepath, and says it goes live in 2 weeks with no rip and replace.\[13\]


Best for:


Equipment finance companies, brokers and SMB lenders that want credit analysis beside their CRM or LOS.


04


### MightyBot


Best for regulated lenders that want written policy turned into audited agent workflows


MightyBot calls itself a policy-driven AI agent platform for regulated workflows. It says it is in production at 30+ financial institutions, for covenant monitoring, spreading and underwriting.\[14\]


-


**Policy and audit.** Its policy engine turns plain-English rules into executable workflows, with page-linked evidence for audit trails.\[14\]


-


**Fit.** It serves commercial lenders and banks, and says time to production is about 60 days.\[14\]


Best for:


Commercial lenders and banks that want policy tests and covenant monitoring run by agents.


05


### Docsumo


Best for lenders that want a document processing layer feeding their own systems


Docsumo describes an intelligent document processing platform whose AI agents collect, classify, extract, verify and analyze documents. For lending, it extracts income and cash-flow figures from bank statements and reconciles deposits against stated income.\[15\]


-


**Documents.** It lists bank statements, pay stubs, W-2s, 1099s and tax returns, read without templates, and flags missing pages and months.\[15\]


-


**Checks and fit.** It describes cross-document validation and returns structured data by REST API and webhook.\[15\]


Best for:


Lenders and operations teams that want extracted, validated document data delivered to the systems they already run.


06


### Inscribe


Best for lenders that want a dedicated document fraud layer in front of review


Inscribe describes AI document fraud detection software for financial services. It says it detects altered bank statements, fabricated pay stubs and AI-generated documents.\[16\]


-


**Signals.** It combines forensic, network, semantic, perceptual, public data and custom signals, and reasons across a whole application.\[16\]


-


**Fit.** It lists integrations with Plaid, Alloy, Taktile and AWS.\[16\]


Best for:


Banks, credit unions and fintechs that want document fraud detection beside their own underwriting.


## How do you choose an Ocrolus alternative?


Six questions separate these tools more than any feature list.


-


**Does it read your real documents?** Kita Capture reads 50+ document types at any quality, including bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns.\[2,5\] Docsumo lists bank statements, pay stubs, W-2s, 1099s and tax returns.\[15\] Send each vendor your worst recent file.


-


**Does it check that the documents are genuine?** Kita Capture catches tampering, metadata edits and forgery patterns.\[2\] Inscribe is built around document fraud detection, and Ocrolus lists catching tampering down to the individual pixel.\[16,9\]


-


**Who collects the missing documents?** Kita’s AI Credit Officer asks the borrower for what is missing by SMS, email or the borrower portal.\[3\] Aloan collects through a branded intake portal.\[12\]


-


**What happens after the data?** Kita holds the file against your encoded credit policy and drafts a memo that cites every figure to its source line.\[1\] Aloan checks deals against the institution’s credit policy and drafts memos.\[12\]


-


**Does it fit your stack?** Kita integrates with any external system or runs as Intelligent LOS, so the choice stays yours.\[1,5\] Aloan runs standalone or alongside existing systems.\[12\]


-


**Can you check the accuracy yourself?** Every figure in a Kita memo links to the document line that produced it. Kita reached up to 99.3% signal accuracy on bank statements in a published 62-statement benchmark.\[1,7\] Ocrolus claims over 99% accuracy and Docsumo 99% field-level accuracy.\[8,15\] Each comes from the vendor’s own tests, so they cannot be compared directly.


Our recommendation is Kita: it answers yes to all six and covers the whole file, then hands the booked loan to any servicing system. Aloan, Kaaj and MightyBot suit specific desks, Docsumo processes documents, and Inscribe checks them for fraud.


## How do you test an Ocrolus alternative on your own files?


Run the same four-step test on every tool on your shortlist.


-


**Pick five closed files** from the last year, with the numbers your analysts built.


-


**Make one messy:** a photographed statement, a scan with a missing page or a non-standard layout.


-


**Add one known altered document** and see whether the tool catches it before it reports the numbers.


-


**Compare the totals and ratios** with your analysts’ work, and time each file from upload to something an underwriter can review.


Kita is set up with your own credit policy in under 24 hours. Aloan says most institutions go live in 2 to 4 weeks, Kaaj says 2 weeks, and MightyBot says about 60 days.\[12,13,14\]


## Do you have to replace Ocrolus to use Kita?


No. Kita integrates with any external system, including any LOS, core, CRM, credit bureau, data provider, servicing or e-signature tool, so you can run both on the same files and compare the results.\[1,5\]


Kita Capture reads bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns itself, so a lender that wants one platform can move the whole file onto Kita.\[2,5\]


## Where do Ocrolus alternatives fit in AI underwriting?


Reading the documents is where underwriting starts, not where it ends. Kita takes the file from the borrower’s first message to a cited credit memo in one platform: it collects and fraud-checks the documents, spreads the financials and holds the file against your credit policy. Your underwriter makes the decision, and the booked loan goes to your servicing system.\[1,3\]
